extraction_notes.method: CloakBrowser (58 C++ anti-detection patches) headless + humanize mode. JavaScript getComputedStyle + CSS custom property scanning. 1440x900 viewport.
extraction_notes.everlane: Minimalist essentials brand. White background, black text, Maison Neue Book font. Shopify Plus with 'Atlas' design system. Zero border-radius everywhere. Clean grid, no card shadows.
extraction_notes.allbirds: Sustainable footwear. Warm oat background (#ece9e2). Geograph custom font. Tailwind v4 with OKLCH colors. Sticky transparent nav. Natural/earthy palette.
extraction_notes.warby_parker: Eyewear DTC pioneer. White + deep navy (#072369). Sans-serif, large hero headings (55px h2). Pill-shaped buttons (36px radius). Blue accent (#1050d0). Custom CSS design system with wp-* tokens.
extraction_notes.gymshark: Athletic wear. Bold typography (Roboto + Druk Condensed Super + Bebas Neue). All headings 700 weight. Dark transparent nav. Hero titles up to 128px. 4px standard radius. Black/white/gray base with colored accents.
extraction_notes.mejuri: Luxury jewelry. Pure black (#000000) sticky nav. SimonMono monospace font (unique differentiator). White text on black. Wide letter-spacing (1.2-2.4px). Oxygen/Shopify Hydrogen stack. 48px h2 hero statements.

palette.primary_role: 主色 — 文字和主要按钮。Everlane用#121212深灰按钮; Mejuri用纯黑#000000作为nav背景; Warby Parker用深海军蓝#072369作为品牌底色
palette.accent_role: 强调色 — Warby Parker链接蓝#1050d0; Gymshark图标蓝#007db5; Everlane促销红#d0021b。仅用于链接、促销标签、图标
palette.surface_role: 背景层次 — 纯白#ffffff(最常用); Allbirds暖燕麦色#ece9e2; Everlane暖白#f8f6f5; Warby Parker暖白#fcfbf9; Gymshark浅灰#f5f5f5。暖色调优先于冷灰
palette.neutral_role: 文字等级 — 纯黑或近黑(#000000/#121212)正文; 中灰#53565a辅助文字; 浅灰#6e6e6e三级文字; #bbbcbc边框
palette.border_role: 边框颜色 — 浅灰系，低对比度。Gymshark #bbbcbc; Warby Parker #c1c6c8; Gymshark #e7e7e7

typography.heading_letter_spacing: -0.5px to 2.4px (wide range: negative for large display, positive for luxury/minimal)

display.note: 超大展示标题。Gymshark hero h2达128px(12.8rem); Mejuri h2达48px; Warby Parker h2达55px

h1.note: 页面标题。Everlane 32px/400; Gymshark 32px/700; Mejuri 24px/500; Allbirds 24px/400

h2.note: 区段标题。Warby Parker 55px hero(极大); Gymshark 25px/700; Allbirds 12px/500

body.note: 正文。16px为最常用基础字号; 辅助文字14px

section_padding.note: Gymshark section 32px padding; 80px spacing tokens. 桌面端section间距偏大

content_max_width.note: 大多数品牌使用全宽布局，content不设max-width。Warby Parker使用grid columns系统

card_padding.note: 产品卡片通常无padding，图片撑满。Everlane卡片内部padding: 0

spacing.spacing_scale: fashion ecommerce使用紧凑间距。典型scale: 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 80px。移动端更紧凑(4px grid gap)

border_radius.buttons: 0px (Everlane, Mejuri, Gymshark minimalist) 到 36px (Warby Parker pill buttons)。两极分化: 极简0或完全圆角pill
border_radius.cards: 0px (大多数品牌): 产品卡片无圆角，图片直接撑满

elevation.shadows: 极轻阴影或无阴影。Fashion ecommerce偏好flat design — 产品卡片通常无box-shadow
typical_values: none (Everlane产品卡片, Gymshark卡片, Mejuri卡片)
0px 2px 8px rgba(55,63,71,0.08), 0px 1px 2px rgba(55,63,71,0.12) (Everlane卡片阴影 — 极轻)
0px 4px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.1) (Gymshark large shadow — 非常大的模糊半径)
0px 20px 48px rgba(55,63,71,0.16), 0px 12px 24px rgba(55,63,71,0.2), 0px 0px 12px rgba(55,63,71,0.08) (Everlane popover — 多层阴影)

typical_order: announcement bar (promo banner, 32px, 背景深色文字白色)
header/nav (sticky or static, logo left/center, hamburger menu on mobile, cart + search icons right)
hero (full-width lifestyle photo, large headline overlay, CTA button, 800px+ height on desktop)
featured categories (2-4 image tiles, clean labels, 圆形或方形)
product grid (3-4 columns desktop, 2 columns tablet, 1-2 mobile, image-heavy, price below)
brand story / values section (Everlane: sustainability, Warby Parker: social mission)
social proof (press logos, reviews, UGC gallery)
footer (multi-column: 4-6 columns, brand links, help, social icons, legal)
hero_variants: 变体1: 全屏生活方式照片 + 文字叠加 (Everlane, Gymshark) — 800px+高度，大标题，1-2个CTA
变体2: 居中文字hero + 浅色/纯色背景 (Warby Parker) — 360px高度，55px大标题，60px上下padding
变体3: 深色背景hero + 白色文字 (Mejuri) — 黑色背景，808px高度，产品+模特图，简洁CTA
变体4: 双CTA hero (Allbirds) — Shop Men / Shop Women 分性别CTA，产品图居中
card_variants: 产品卡片: image-first, 0px圆角, 无shadow, flex column布局, 商品名+价格在图片下方, 多图hover切换
分类卡片: 大图+文字标签, 方形或横向, 无边框, 文字居中或左下角
blog/内容卡片: 0px圆角(Everlane blog), 轻微shadow, 图片+标题+摘要

nav_patterns.everlane: Static header, white bg #ffffff, logo center, 74px height, 372 links (mega menu), text links dark
nav_patterns.allbirds: Sticky transparent header, overlay on hero, 0px reported height (JS-rendered), 203 links
nav_patterns.warby_parker: Static transparent header, dark text #121212, logo centered, 18 links (minimal nav), 40px height (truncated by JS)
nav_patterns.gymshark: Static transparent header, white text on dark sections, 76px height, 141 links, gender-split nav
nav_patterns.mejuri: Sticky black header #000000, white text, 57px height, 8 links (minimal luxury nav), logo left

tone_profile.headline_style: Short, bold, aspirational. 3-8 words. Fashion uses lifestyle-benefit headlines rather than feature descriptions. 例: 'MADE FOR SUMMER' (Everlane), 'New frames, made for play' (Warby Parker), 'The Summer Guide' (Mejuri), 'TREE RUNNER — Wildly Comfortable. Blissfully Breathable.' (Allbirds)
tone_profile.cta_style: Direct action verbs: 'Shop Now', 'Shop Men / Shop Women', 'Start the quiz', 'Discover', 'Shop the Collection'. Rarely longer than 3 words. Everlane uses arrow prefix: '→ SHOP THE COLLECTION'
trust_signals: Customer reviews / star ratings near product cards
Sustainability badges (Everlane: ethical factories; Allbirds: carbon neutral; Warby Parker: buy a pair give a pair)
Press quotes/logos ('As seen in Vogue, GQ, etc.')
Newsletter signup (10-15% off first order incentive)
anti_patterns: Do NOT use heavy box shadows on cards (fashion = flat, image-forward)
Do NOT use colored backgrounds behind product images (always white/natural)
Do NOT use serif fonts for body text (Mejuri is exception with monospace)
Do NOT use small, text-heavy descriptions on product cards (max: name + price)
Do NOT use bright/neon colors for primary UI elements (palette stays neutral)
Do NOT use complex multi-level dropdowns (mega-menu or simple flyout preferred)
Avoid dark mode (all 5 brands use light backgrounds)

color_mood: Warm Neutral (Everlane, Allbirds): 白底+暖燕麦/米色+深灰文字。温暖、自然、可持续感。适合: 环保、极简、日常服饰
High Contrast (Mejuri, Warby Parker): 纯白+纯黑/深海军蓝。干净、锐利、奢华感。适合: 高端、珠宝、设计师品牌
Athletic Bold (Gymshark): 白底+黑文字+高饱和强调色。活力、力量、年轻。适合: 运动、街头、潮流
typography_mood: Minimal Sans (Everlane, Warby Parker, Allbirds): 细体/常规字重标题(400-500), 清晰易读。'安静的自信'。适合: 极简、DTC、中高端
Bold Athletic (Gymshark): 全粗体标题(700), 压缩字体(Druk Condensed Super, Bebas Neue), 大写。'响亮、有力'。适合: 运动、街头、年轻品牌
Editorial Mono (Mejuri): 等宽字体(SimonMono), 宽字母间距, 杂志感。'精致、有态度'。适合: 奢侈、珠宝、编辑型品牌
layout_density: Airy & Spacious (Everlane, Mejuri): 大量留白，单列hero，图片主导，文字极少。适合: 高端、极简
Energetic & Dense (Gymshark): 多种内容密度混合，多区块快速切换，视频+图片轮播。适合: 快时尚、运动
Balanced (Warby Parker, Allbirds): hero后紧接分类卡片+产品网格，经典ecommerce密度。适合: 大多数DTC品牌
button_style: Zero-radius flat (Everlane, Mejuri): 0px圆角，纯色填充，文字大写或regular。极简
Pill rounded (Warby Parker): 36px全圆角，outline样式(边框1px)，'友好、可接近'
Standard (Gymshark): 4px圆角，可变背景色，功能优先

everlane.typography: Maison Neue Book (headings) / Assistant, sans-serif (body). 400 weight headings (light/minimal). 15-16px body.
everlane.radius: 0px everywhere — cards, buttons, inputs, blog cards, collection cards
everlane.nav: Static, white bg, logo center, mega-menu with 372 links, 74px height
everlane.hero: Full-width lifestyle photo, 806px height, headline + arrow CTA overlay
everlane.cards: Flex column, no shadow, no radius, 0px padding. 5 images per product card (multi-angle hover). Left-aligned text.
everlane.signature: A11Y-first with skip-to-content; Atlas design system with detailed CSS custom properties; arrow-prefixed CTAs

allbirds.typography: Geograph, system-ui, sans-serif. Tailwind v4 fluid type scale. 16px body, 24px h1. OKLCH color space.
allbirds.radius: 0px on cards/buttons. Custom clip-path for pill shapes (skewed pill SVG mask).
allbirds.nav: Sticky, transparent, overlay on hero. Large link count (203).
allbirds.hero: Dual-gender CTA (Shop Men / Shop Women), product image centered, 784px height, warm oat background showing through
allbirds.cards: Grid display, 12px gap, image-heavy. No shadow, no radius.
allbirds.signature: Tailwind v4 with modern OKLCH color tokens; custom SVG clip-paths; warm natural tones throughout

warby_parker.typography: sans-serif system font stack. 55px hero h2 (400 weight, -0.55px letter-spacing). 20px h3 (700 weight). 16px body.
warby_parker.radius: 36px pill buttons (signature), 20px skip-link, 4px nav items, 0px modals
warby_parker.nav: Static, transparent, centered logo, minimal 18 links, dark text on light bg
warby_parker.hero: Centered text hero, 360px height, 60px vertical padding, no background image (text-focused)
warby_parker.cards: N/A on homepage (uses category tiles rather than product cards). Grid system: 8 cols tablet, desktop offset 48px.
warby_parker.signature: Pill-shaped outline buttons (1px solid border, 36px radius); deep navy #072369 brand color; sophisticated shadow system

gymshark.typography: Roboto body; Druk Condensed Super + Bebas Neue headings. All headings 700 weight. 32px h1, 25px h2, 14px h3. Hero titles up to 128px.
gymshark.nav: Static, transparent, gender-split (Women/Men), 76px+ height, white text overlay, 141 links
gymshark.hero: Full-width lifestyle/action photos, massive 6010px scroll height (multi-section scroller), 176 images on main page
gymshark.cards: Block display, no shadow, no radius, 0px padding. 2 images per card. Dense mobile-first grid.
gymshark.signature: Bold athletic typography with Druk Condensed Super; massive hero titles; gender-split navigation; Glassmorphism (blur(50px) backdrop); particle design system

mejuri.typography: SimonMono, Courier New, monospace (signature font choice). 24px h1 (500 weight, 1.2px letter-spacing). 48px h2 (500 weight, 2.4px letter-spacing). 16px body.
mejuri.nav: Sticky, black bg #000000, white text, 57px height, minimal 8 links (luxury simplicity)
mejuri.hero: Black background, white text, 808px height, product+lifestyle imagery, single CTA: 'Shop Now'
mejuri.cards: No shadow, no radius, no padding. Pure image-first display.
mejuri.signature: Monospace font as luxury differentiator; wide letter-spacing for editorial feel; pure black/white palette; Shopify Oxygen/Hydrogen stack

product_card.layout: image_stack (1-5 images, primary + hover alternates) > product_name > price
product_card.shadow: none (universal in default state, minimal on hover at most)
product_card.interactions: hover: swap to second product image (Everlane, Gymshark), slight opacity/zoom
product_card.badges: Sale (red #d0021b), New Arrival, Best Seller, Sustainable

variants: sticky + transparent → solid on scroll (Allbirds, Gymshark)
navigation.logo_position: center (Everlane, Warby Parker) or left (Gymshark, Mejuri, Allbirds)
navigation.cart_icon: right side, often with count badge
navigation.mobile: hamburger menu, full-screen overlay or drawer

footer.background: white #ffffff (Everlane, Warby Parker, Mejuri) or transparent (Allbirds, Gymshark)
footer.padding: minimal top padding (30px Gymshark), generous internal spacing
